channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump signals shift to economic pressure on Iran over new military strikes
item.description: US relying on sanctions and naval blockade as oil prices stabilise, easing economic strain on American consumers.

item.title: Oil prices climb as Iranian demands cloud outlook for Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Brent crude prices rise as Tehran says critical waterway will not reopen without major US concessions.

item.title: Houthis launch fresh ballistic missile and drone attacks on al-Makha port
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis have resumed attacks on Yemen’s al-Makha port in the Red Sea.

item.title: New Houthi missile and drone attacks kill seven in Yemen’s al-Makha
item.description: The latest Houthi attacks come less than 24 hours after an earlier barrage struck al-Makha and its commercial port.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran says ‘no military solution’ to Hormuz reopening
item.description: Trump says US will wait for economic pressure to mount on Iran, as Israel formally rejects 15-point Gaza peace plan.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian strike on Russia's Tatarstan region, officials say
item.description: It is one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since the start of Moscow's war on Ukraine.

item.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
item.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

item.title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
item.description: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations in historic, Palestinian areas of the West Bank.

item.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
item.description: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.
